technical-data.invention-title: CIRCUIT CARD SUPPORT MECHANISM AND METHOD
MECANISME ET PROCEDE DE SUPPORT DE CARTE A CIRCUIT

abstract.p: A support mechanism for a part of a circuit card (68) includes a support member (slide) (90) which forms a fixed part. The support member defines a guide (94). It also includes a slideable member (92) for engaging the circuit card. The slideable member (slider) is slideable along the guide to a position for engaging the card (68). The slider defines a jaw for engaging the circuit card. The jaw can be provided with a protrusion for engaging with a hole in the corner of a circuit card, for example a PCI card. The mechanism enables the supporting of the cards of different lengths due to the slideability of the slide along the guide. The guide and the slider can be formed with inter-engaging structures of appropriate shapes, for example, co-operating dovetail shapes.

Ce mécanisme de support, destiné à une partie d'une carte à circuit (68) comprend un élément de support (coulisse) (90) formant une partie fixe et définissant une glissière (94). Ce mécanisme de support comprend également un élément coulissant (92) destiné à entrer en contact avec la carte à circuit. L'élément coulissant (coulisseau) peut glisser le long de la glissière pour se mettre dans une position d'emboîtement de la carte (68), et il définit une mâchoire de serrage de la carte à circuit. Cette mâchoire peut être dotée d'un élément saillant destiné à pénétrer dans un trou ménagé dans le coin d'une carte à circuit, par exemple une carte à circuit imprimé. Ce mécanisme permet le support de cartes de longueurs différentes, par suite de la possibilité de coulissement du coulisseau le long de la glissière. La glissière et le coulisseau peuvent être formés de manière à présenter des structures d'emboîtement, de formes adéquates, par exemple, des formes du type queue d'aronde.

description.p: BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
This invention relates to a mechanism and method for supporting a circuit card within a housing Vaπous standard forms of circuit cards are known, for example, circuit cards in accordance with the PCI

(Peπpheral Component Interconnect) standards Such cards are provided with electrical and mechanical mountings along first and second edges, which means that there is a free corner of the card which is typically unsupported This can lead to problems in environments where vibration is possible

In some applications, extremely strict standards are set with regard to the ability to withstand vibration of a unit comprising such a card For example, m the telecommunications environment, there are extremely rigorous requirements with regard to ensuring that components can operate reliably when subject to vibration due to normal office and/or seismic causes

There is a need, therefore, to define a structure that can minimise the vulnerability of a card to vibration One difficulty in addressing this with respect to the mounting of, for example, a card such as a PCI card, is that the length of the card may not be defined by the appropπate standards, for example by the PCI standard specification As a result, individual cards may have different lengths

An aim of the invention is to provide a mechanism and method of supporting a part of a circuit card, for example the free corner of a PCI card, which can address the problem of minimizing vibration, while taking account of the fact that different cards to be supported may be of different lengths
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

Particular and preferred aspects of the mvention are set out in the accompanymg mdependent and dependent claims Combinations of features from the dependent claims may be combined with features of the mdependent claims as appropriate and not merely as explicitly set out in the claims In accordance with one aspect of the invention, there is provided a support mechanism for a circuit card

The support mechanism mcludes a support member that defines a guide A card engagmg member has a guide follower that shdeably engages the guide such that the card engaging member is slideable with respect to the support member to a position at which it engages the circuit card

An embodiment of the present invention thus enables the supporting of a part of the circuit card, for example a free corner, through the card engaging member (slider) and the support member (slide), which cooperate to support the card The provision of the sliding inter-engagement of the slider and the slide means that the slider be slid along the guide on the slide to a position appropnate for supporting a card of any one of a number of lengths This facilitates the initial installation of a card, as one support mechanism can support many different card lengths Accordingly, it is not necessary to hold a set of different supports for different cards Also, it facilitates the replacement of the circuit card, as the slider can simply be adjusted to a position appropriate for another card of another length

An advantageous arrangement is for one of the guide and the guide follower to be configured as a rail and the other of the guide and guide follower to be configured as a slot havmg a complementary shape to the rail The rail can project from the member on which it is formed so that the slot formed on the other member simply
engages over e projec ing rai

The slider can be arranged to be held in a slideable engagement with respect to the slide simply by means of the inter-engagement of the slot and the rail, without any other securing arrangements For example, the rail can have a head portion that is wider than a base portion One example of this provides a rail with a dovetail- shaped cross-section

The guide on the slide may be m the form of a rail, with the guide follower on the slider having the slot of co-operating shape Alternatively, the guide follower on the slider may be in the form of a rail, with the guide follower on the slide havmg the slot of co-operating shape

The slider may have first and second projections forming a jaw for receivmg the circuit card The first and second projections can thus define a slot therebetween for receiving the circuit card The slider can mclude a projection, for example within the slot, for engaging in a hole in the circuit card

In a preferred embodiment of the invention, the slide mcludes a wall portion for dividing a card receivmg bay from a further bay within a housmg The slide can also mclude formations for securing the slide within the housmg These can take the form of, for example, a flange and/or a threaded hole for receivmg a screw The slide and/or the slider can be formed of an insulating plastics mateπal

In accordance with another aspect of the mvention, there is provided electrical apparatus mcludmg a housmg, a circuit card and a support mechanism for supporting a part of the circuit card within the housmg The support mechanism mcludes a support member (slide) defining a guide and a card engagmg member (slider) havmg a guide follower that shdeably engages the guide such that the slider is slideable with respect to the support member to a position to engage the part (e g a free corner) of the circuit card

The electrical apparatus can further mclude a processor card carrying a processor The slide can be configured to form a dividing wall between a circuit card bay for receivmg the circuit card and a processor card bay for receivmg the processor card The slide can thus serve to separate respective flows of coolmg air over the circuit card and the processor card from respective fan units This enable minimisation of the airflow needed for the respective cards (typically a processor card will require more coolmg than other cards) and with this a minimisation of the noise generated and optimisation of power consumption for the electrical apparatus as a whole The apparatus could, for example, be a computer mcludmg a processor and a further circuit card (e g a PCI card)

In accordance with a further aspect of the mvention, there is provided a method of supporting part of a circuit card (e g , a free corner of a PCI card) within a housing, the method compπsmg locatmg a support guide within the housmg and sliding a card engagmg member (slider) havmg a guide follower along the guide to a position at which the card engagmg member engages the part of the card

An embodiment of the mvention is thus able to accommodate and support a circuit card of any one of a range of lengths m a flexible manner that facilitates initial installation and subsequent replacement of such cards
